reference.source: original design inspired by Nie Feng motifs from Feng Yun: wind god legwork, snow-drinking blade, cold wind martial hero
identity_notes: original white-and-ice-blue wuxia swordsman, inspired by wind and snow motifs rather than a direct comic costume copy
long dark hair, pale blue scarf and short wind-torn cloak
large icy white curved blade held or carried as the primary silhouette
wind-step leg motion with cyan gust trails around the feet
snowflake and frost highlights for cast and attack frames
